site.name: Global Move
site.description: Your trusted partner for relocation, rentals and premium property services in the world's most exclusive destinations.

hero.headline:
We move you,
you live better.
hero.subheadline: We accompany individuals and families through every step of their international move. From finding the perfect home to full settling-in support in your destination.

services.headline: Your new life in Spain, in four steps
services.subheadline: We combine local expertise with personal attention so your move to Spain is seamless, secure and memorable. Rentals, sales, relocation and concierge under one roof.

relocation.title: Relocation
relocation.description: We accompany your move to Spain: NIE, visas, school search, healthcare registration and bank accounts. No stress, no paperwork.

rentals.title: Holiday rentals
rentals.description: Curated selection of premium villas and apartments for short or long stays. Clear contracts, private check-in and 24/7 support.

sales.title: Property sales
sales.description: Full advisory for buying or selling high-end properties. Access to off-market opportunities and due diligence with specialised lawyers.

concierge.title: Concierge
concierge.description: Personal 24/7 attention: transfers, private chef, bookings, local recommendations and every daily need during your stay.

destinations.headline: Spain, in its finest enclaves
destinations.subheadline: We operate exclusively in Spain. We cover the most sought-after destinations for those seeking quality of life, tax efficiency and investment opportunities.

settling.description: We support you through your first months with continuous assistance.

testimonials.headline: Stories from those who already took the leap

one.quote: Global Move made our move to Marbella completely stress-free. Their attention to detail and network of contacts made all the difference.
one.author: The Müller family

two.quote: As an international investor, I value the team's discretion and professionalism. They found off-market properties that don't appear on any portal.
two.author: James R.

three.quote: Moving to Ibiza with three kids seemed impossible. They handled school, house and all paperwork. I just enjoyed the ride.
three.author: Sophie L.
